findings.address_as_written: Enlargement of the Kezar Memorial Stadium
findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners authorized Masten & Hurd, architects, to finish plans and specifications for enlarging Kezar Memorial Stadium.

citation.label: Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners, January 10, 1928

findings.address_as_written: Lafayette Square - exchange of land with The Lurie Company
findings.description: Finding itself without power under the Charter and the Congressional grant to trade parkland, the Board of Park Commissioners urged the city to accept The Lurie Company's offer to exchange the eastern part of the strip where Clay Street would run if extended into Lafayette Square for an equal area of the western part of the company's privately held lots in the square, the land gained to be dedicated as part of the park.

findings.description: With J. A. Bryant the low bidder on the enlargement of Kezar Memorial Stadium and not enough money yet for the whole job, the Board of Park Commissioners awarded him a first part of the work so the much-needed enlargement would not be delayed.
